author: bfonta
body:
Set of minor improvements on the `PFBlock` linking (weighted quick union) algorithm: 

+ Avoid multiple calls to `.size()`
+ Avoid additional calls to `.type()`, including moving the definition of `type1` to its corresponding outer loop
+ Remove duplicated logic when computing the distance between two elements in the (removed) `links()` method
+ Remove a spurious parent assignment in the `unite()` method of the weighted quick union, which can lead to a cycle in the node chain if `p` is a root node. The cycle was broken by the `find` function (path halving), leading AFAICT to correct results, but the implementation was in general not precise and included extra instructions.
+ The storage of the root notes in the `keys` vector was simplified and sped-up
+ The code was reserving a number of blocks equal to the number of elements, while we only need to reserve a number equal to the root nodes, since each root node leads to one block.

The logic and essential structure of the algorithm is not changed.
title: Feature/pfalgo improv
